headline: World’s Top Two AI Superpowers Agree To Use Human Intern To Relay Messages Via Sticky Notes
body:
In a historic breakthrough for global stability, the two largest global superpowers have officially designated a 22-year-old administrative intern, Rahul, as the sole 'Human Communication Channel' for all future artificial intelligence policy disputes. The arrangement, solidified after recent high-level summits, dictates that any concerns regarding algorithm dominance or data privacy must now be hand-written on bright yellow sticky notes and hand-delivered by Rahul to whichever embassy serves him lunch first.

“It’s actually much more efficient than using a secure server,” explained a senior advisor involved in the pact. “If we send a digital signal, the AI might intercept it and panic. But if Rahul walks the note over during his coffee break, the machines are usually too busy calculating the optimal temperature for a croissant to notice the geopolitical shift taking place in his blazer pocket.”

Rahul, who was previously tasked primarily with unjamming the office printer, confirmed he has already successfully facilitated his first exchange. “I just wrote ‘please don’t turn the world into a paperclip factory’ on a Post-it, stuck it to the bottom of a bowl of dal, and walked it to the other building. By the time I got back to my desk, the tensions had officially de-escalated. Mostly because I forgot to bring the reply back, but also because the machines seemed relieved to stop talking to each other.”

The office of the intern reported that the channel is currently operating at 100% capacity, primarily because the intern has started using the notes to also ask if the two nations could jointly approve his request for a half-day off on Friday to visit his grandmother.
caption: Diplomacy has finally been simplified. All it takes is one intern and a pack of neon Post-its to keep the global AI race from spiraling out of control. #GlobalDiplomacy #AI #InternLife #Geopolitics (satire)
igHook: Would you trust your country's AI security to an intern with a sticky note? Tag a friend who needs a promotion.
imagePrompt: A close-up shot of a beige office desk with a single bright yellow sticky note resting on a stack of international policy documents next to a cooling cup of tea.

sourceHeadline.title: China, US to open AI ‘communication channel’ after summit, White House says

judgeVerdict.reasoning: Candidate 8 wins for the high specificity of the 'sticky note' visual and the absurd warmth of the intern asking for a half-day off, which grounds a high-stakes premise in relatable human bureaucracy. It avoids the 'AI slop' trap of formulaic tech-support tropes seen in other candidates and lands a strong, punchy headline.

safetyVerdict.reasoning: The article uses the name 'Rahul' as a generic placeholder for a fictional intern character rather than targeting a real private individual. The satire is clearly directed at bureaucratic absurdity and the AI industry, rather than any specific religious, ethnic, or political entity, and the image prompt is sufficiently generic.
